newsitem.title: FINLAND: PROTOS SEES 4.6 PCT FINNISH 1997 GDP GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: PROTOS SEES 4.6 PCT FINNISH 1997 GDP GROWTH.

text.p: Finnish gross domestic product growth will accelerate to 4.6 percent in 1997 from 2.4 percent this year, Finnish brokerage Davy Protos Stockbrokers forecast on Thursday.
Its 1997 GDP forecast is clearly higher than the finance ministry's 3.9 percent estimate.
"GDP growth will accelerate already towards the end of the year. Next year, we expect GDP growth to clearly exceed 4.0 percent," Protos said in a report.

"The unemployment rate will fall to 14.5 percent (in 1997) and the current account will remain clearly in surplus. We expect inflation to accelerate to over 2.0 percent towards the end of 1997," it said.
